question: Which district has both stores with less than 3000 products and stores with more than 10000 products?

FROM shop s1

WHERE s1.number_products < 3000 AND s2.number_products > 10000;

SELECT shop.district
FROM shop
WHERE shop.number_products < 3000 OR shop.number_products > 10000
GROUP BY shop.district
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN shop.number_products < 3000 THEN 1 END) > 0 
   AND COUNT(CASE WHEN shop.number_products > 10000 THEN 1 END) > 0;

FROM shop
WHERE shop.number_products < 3000
GROUP BY shop.district
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN shop.number_products > 10000 THEN 1 END) > 0

FROM shop
WHERE shop.number_products > 10000
GROUP BY shop.district
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN shop.number_products < 3000 THEN 1 END) > 0
sql_retrieved:
SELECT district
FROM shop
GROUP BY district
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN number_products < 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN number_products > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;
sql_perfect:

JOIN degree_programs ON student_enrolment.degree_program_id = degree_programs.degree_program_id
